item.coloph: kong yul gnas chen dbus phug nas/ 'phags rigs sngags 'chang bdag gis thon/ lha brag mtsho gling dben gnas su/ brda ri dag phab bde chen gling / bstan 'gror phan bde'i lam zin nas/ bstan pa rin chen rgyas 'gyur cig/
